limits.horizon_basis: Aave V4 has no cooldown, vesting, epoch or auction. Its only time-dependent state is interest accrual (AssetLogic.accrue: drawn index and premium, per second), and AaveOracle has no staleness check, so prices stay at the block's on the fork (external price adapters such as Pendle PT discount feeds move with time on their own). One day lets a PoC show anything that needs interest to accrue; AccessManager delays belong to trusted roles. Not the damage window.

tokens._note: Priced as WETH. No Aave V4 contract holds ETH; it is capital for PoCs that need gas money or swaps (cap = WETH flash-loanable) and is measured for every holder.
